# Chaikin Oscillator

*Fast minus slow EMA of accumulation/distribution.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Chaikin Oscillator** under **Volume**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fast length | int | `3` |
| Slow length | int | `10` |
| Color | color | `"#EC407A"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/chaikinosc.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Chaikin Oscillator", shortTitle: "Chaikin Osc", overlay: false, format: "volume" });
const fast = input.int("Fast length", 3, { min: 1 }), slow = input.int("Slow length", 10, { min: 1 });
const ad = ta.accdist();
plot(ta.calc([ta.ema(ad, fast), ta.ema(ad, slow)], (f, s) => f - s), { title: "Chaikin Oscillator", color: input.color("Color", "#EC407A", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
